name: image-to-text-ocr
title: Image to Text OCR: Tables, Invoices & Scans, 38 Languages
description: Extract text and tables from images and scanned PDFs in bulk: invoices, receipts, price lists, screenshots. Ruled and borderless tables as rows of cells, numbers as printed. 38 languages incl. Ukrainian and Russian (Cyrillic), Tesseract, auto-rotate. Lines and words with confidence and boxes.
